protocol: FRESH TEST labels for live_ppo/eval/eval_units.py: AGENT-LABELLED 2026-11-20, PRE-FILLED FROM WEIGHTS B (runs/det_v3_pod/ab/B/weights/last.pt), PENDING HUMAN CHECK. Test material: nothing from this video may enter a training set or be used to tune anything. Frames: match_audit.py sample --stratify (60 per video, seed 0, no bursts, 15 per tracked-unit-count bin 0-2 / 3-5 / 6-9 / 10+). Method (runs/match_audit/<src>/sample/REVIEW.md): units counted on the clean frame before reading the detector's boxes, then the pre-filled list corrected (false boxes deleted, missed units added, class / form / side fixed) against zoom crops and neighbouring frames. NOT blind to the detector in the sense of the three older files: recall measured here is an upper bound. Schema as labels_units_vid_uVf1EUszTIM.json: tile = continuous detector-grid ground point (x 0..17, y 0..31 from our King side); troops: feet; flyers: bottom of the body; buildings: footprint centre; a pre-filled tile was moved only when it was more than about one tile off. ref = tile_to_ref(tile). Flags: swarm, fly, bld, tower, river (set by rule from class / tile); occ, spell, deploy, formq, sideq, gpq (ground point uncertain, usually a hidden unit placed from its level badge), spl (spell area or projectile, not a unit; dropped by eval_units).
status: agent-labelled 2026-11-20, pre-filled from weights B (runs/det_v3_pod/ab/B/weights/last.pt), pending human check

conventions: deploy = the deploy timer is showing on or next to the unit, in ANY state (part-filled, white completion flash, or full), or the card was just released (card caption and elixir drop up, figure still faint, timer not drawn yet). All units of a deploying group carry it. A timer the unit has already left behind by more than about 2 tiles does not count. A full timer lingers about 0.5 s after the unit becomes active, so some deploy-flagged units are already moving.
A unit dropping in (drawn high or not drawn yet, badge and timer up) is labelled at its landing spot with deploy + gpq, class from the following frames.

Not units, not labelled: drag previews (placement square / range circle, no elixir drop), goblin-barrel placement ghosts, the mighty miner's bomb, underground miners, death splashes, rage clouds, captions, emotes, tower decorations, King-tower shots, unit projectiles (hunter pellets, bowler boulder, firecracker rocket, a mace lying at the river in LekrcVeQjiw 61875).
Spells and projectile cards in flight or active get an spl entry (goblin-barrel, royal-delivery, the-log, earthquake).
Hidden units known from a level badge plus neighbouring frames are labelled occ + gpq.

Translucent, just-released skeleton armies are labelled only where single skeletons can be separated (kaLMeKpsuGY 17235: 11 of 15, 37740: 5 of 15, 39510: 8 of 15, 43500: 10 of 15): the unlabelled rest will count against precision if a detector finds them.
Form: plain shield badge = base, diamond = Evo, crown = hero / champion; hit-flash tint is not a form cue. Where the form could not be read the detector's form is kept with formq.

LekrcVeQjiw: our gold-skin cannon and our ice golem are formq in every frame (skin vs Evo / hero form not settled; the detector itself flips between ice-golem and ice-golem-hero on the same unit). Our musketeer is musketeer-hero (crown badge). The purple enemy boulder-thrower with a crown badge is bowler-hero + formq.
kaLMeKpsuGY: bottom / blue side is ours. Own units at full health show no badge; enemy units always show a red one.
